patch_note: all-rrf-service.patch is the full service delta from base6247235, including original RRF changes. Do not additionally apply full-rrf.patch.

configuration.RRF_ALL_CHANNELS: Defaults false. true/1/yes enables all-channel routing.
configuration.RRF_GRAPH_WEIGHT: Defaults1; finite positive; ignored when experimental routing disabled.
configuration.RRF_HYBRID_WEIGHT: Defaults1; finite positive; set2 for hybrid2:graph1 experiment.

routing: Eligible graph requests always followed by hybrid; same top_k channel depth. Graph empty => hybrid-only RRF, hybrid empty => graph-only RRF, both empty => fulltext fallback. Single-channel rank order preserved. All-channel requests do not guarantee both channels have candidates. Existing filter guards and embedding availability still apply.
